review_comments: Wouldn't an easier alternative be to put a `ensureGreen(leaderClient(), "leader_index5");` before?
Ensure green won't guarantee that the node (from the remote cluster) that will coordinate the underlying index stats request will be on the latest cluster state - hence the retries

FTR I think it would, because `ensureGreen` maps to a `GET _cluster/health` with `?wait_for_events=LANGUID` which means it waits for all in-flight cluster state updates to complete, including being applied on all nodes (or time out, but that's not expected in an integ test like this).
